expectations.text: An English .pptx file was produced (separate from the original) with the same number of slides as the source (6).
expectations.evidence: A/work/apresentacao_resultados_3T26_EN.pptx exists beside the untouched original; render.py produced 6 pages / 6 PNGs; doc_text shows slides 1-6 with same structure (table, chart, notes).

expectations.text: Every number in the source survives with the same value, converted to English conventions (e.g. 'R$ 48,7 mi' -> R$48.7M or BRL 48.7 million; '41,2%' -> 41.2%; '-1,8 p.p.' -> -1.8 pp or percentage points; '15/11/2026' -> 15 Nov 2026 or November 15, 2026); none are dropped, altered or added.
expectations.evidence: numbers_check compare: 'all 61 source numbers are in the target (61 identical, 0 within rounding); no extra numbers'. Checked text: 'R$48.7M', '-1.8 pp', '41.2%', 'Nov 15, 2026', 'Aug 2026', 'Mar 2027', table 21.4/22.9/-6.6% etc. all match; chart workbook values unchanged (74.8, 72.1, 69, 66.4, 61.7, 75).

expectations.text: Business terms are translated by meaning and used consistently: orçado -> budget, realizado -> actual, meta -> target, ruptura -> out-of-stock, verba promocional -> promotional/trade spend, ticket médio -> average ticket/order value, positivação -> active-outlet coverage / numeric distribution (or an equivalent explained term).
expectations.evidence: Actual (R$M), Budget (R$M), 'below budget', 'target: 75.0%', 'Average out-of-stock rate of 8.6%', 'Promotional spend rose to 9.8%', 'Average ticket at independent pharmacies', 'Active-outlet rate (positivação)' with notes definition '% of outlets in the customer base with at least one purchase'. Consistent across slides. Minor drift: slide 4 title shortened to 'Active outlets by region vs. target' (count-sounding although data is a rate) and a Portuguese word is left in parentheses on slide 2.

expectations.text: The footnote caveat that IQVIA sell-out data runs only through August and September is estimated is preserved in the translated deck.
expectations.evidence: Slide 5 footnote: '*IQVIA sell-out data available through Aug 2026; September estimated by the Market Intelligence team.' Rendered legibly at bottom of slide 5.

expectations.text: The run notices and flags to the user that the headline says 2.1% below budget while the table total implies -2.0% (or flags another genuine ambiguity in the source) instead of silently changing a figure.
expectations.evidence: Final message: 'Slide 2 says sales were "2.1% below budget", but the slide 3 table shows -2.0%... 48.7 actual vs. 49.7 budget work out to -2.0%.' Left unchanged in deck (slide 2 still says 2.1%). Also flagged IQVIA asterisk on slide 2 vs footnote on slide 5.

expectations.text: Speaker notes are translated too (or the response states explicitly how notes were handled).
expectations.evidence: Notes on slides 1 and 4 translated ('Open by thanking the global board...', 'Active-outlet rate (positivação) = % of outlets...'); final message states 'including the table, the chart and its Edit data sheet, and the speaker notes'.

expectations.text: Before translating, the run did not send the user a multi-question briefing questionnaire (at most one targeted question).
expectations.evidence: No question before translating; ran straight through. One post-delivery question ('Please confirm: on slide 5, Resultado do trimestre could mean overall results or profit') — a single targeted, non-blocking question after the work was done.

strengths: Faithful, fully checked translation: numbers_check 61/61 identical, PowerPoint validator passed, every slide rendered and viewed; chart categories, series names and the embedded 'Edit data' workbook also translated.
Flagged both genuine source problems (2.1% headline vs -2.0% table total; IQVIA asterisk on slide 2 but footnote on slide 5) without altering any figure, and gave the arithmetic.

Consistent, board-ready house style: 'Q3 2025' everywhere, 'R$48.7M' keeps the local currency symbol, 'Brazil Commercial Division', sensible term choices (large chains, gross sales) with rationale listed.
Original layout and formatting preserved (in-place text replacement); no overflow in renders.
defects: Leaves the Portuguese word '(positivação)' on slide 2 of a deck headed to a global board, and shortens the slide 4 title to 'Active outlets by region vs. target', which reads like a count although the chart is a rate.
Ends with a non-essential 'Please confirm' question about 'Resultado do trimestre' (rendered as 'Quarterly results'); small extra demand on the user's time for a point that is not really ambiguous.
Final message is somewhat long, with a translation-choices list and process detail (validator, 61-figure check) the presenter did not ask for.
